description: Capture one competitor's real pages for research: Stravue finds the pages that answer the ask, shoots them full-page on desktop and phone, and drafts comments that quote the page. TO COMPARE SEVERAL COMPETITORS, call this once per competitor with the SAME `comparison` name, then use get_comparison, export_comparison_slide and export_comparison_deck: the result is every competitor side by side on one slide and one deck, which is the thing to hand a person. Two modes: `urls` captures exactly those pages; `site` plus `ask` maps the site and picks the pages. A capture takes MINUTES, so this returns an id immediately; poll get_capture. A new account's first captures run on free pages, and the response says how many are left. If the site has nothing matching the ask the API answers 422 rather than capturing a guess.

ask.description: What you are after, in plain words (max 200 characters), e.g. 'pricing and plans'. Used with `site` to pick the pages.

comparison.description: A name that groups competitors into ONE comparison, e.g. 'scheduling-pricing'. Send the same name on every competitor's capture; the response carries the comparison_id to read it back.

device.description: Primary device for the capture. Default desktop.

project.description: Optional Stravue project id to file the capture under.

site.description: A site to map and judge, e.g. 'stripe.com'. Requires `ask`.

name: capture
title: Capture a competitor
